Preview next Visual/Performing Arts lesson.

rpk: Learners speak the local language daily and learned songs, reading, writing and grammar basics in Basic 1-3.
starter: Greet learners; 1-minute 'book talk': teacher shows and names a book from the class collection.

plenary: 2-3 learners share their favourite part with the class.
Teacher displays the reading log and praises consistent readers.

Encourage learners to borrow a book for the week.

plenary: Recite the golden rule / a memory verse / a wise saying together.
Commitment question: 'What will you do differently from today?'
Homework: share today's moral lesson with family and do one good deed.
Close with an inclusive prayer/song; preview next lesson.
